questions: Your friend is walking out the door angry mid-conversation. Write what you'd say in the next ten seconds to make them stay.
Your partner just texted 'I think we should take a break.' Write your reply.
Someone you love is boarding a flight to move across the country in an hour. Write the voicemail you'd leave them right now.
A close friend has gone silent on you for three weeks. Draft the message you'd send tonight.
Your sibling just said 'I don't think I want you in my life anymore.' Write what you say back.
You're in the middle of an argument and your partner just said 'forget it' and turned away. Write what you'd say to pull them back into the conversation.
A mentor who changed your life is retiring tomorrow and you haven't said goodbye. Write the message you'd send them tonight.
Your best friend found out you lied to them and won't pick up. Leave the voicemail.
Someone you love is in the hospital and only has time for one visitor. Write what you'd say on the phone to convince them to pick you.
Your partner just said quietly 'I don't think you love me anymore.' Write your response.
